Markets.title: Brent trades near month's high as Mideast conflict threatens supply
Markets.summary: Brent crude futures are trading near a monthly high due to supply threats from Middle Eastern conflicts and Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian refineries. Analysts predict that these ongoing disruptions to oil exports could push prices above $100 per barrel.

Markets.title: Dollar lingers near 22-month peak as AI worries simmer
Markets.summary: The U.S. dollar is holding near a 22-month peak, supported by expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. Meanwhile, traders are monitoring the performance of AI-related stocks, which analysts say could impact currencies like the Australian and Mexican pesos.

Markets.title: Gold steady, heads for weekly gain as markets await Fed signals
Markets.summary: Gold prices remained steady while investors awaited upcoming interest rate guidance from the US Federal Reserve. Meanwhile, October imports showed an uptick in China's demand for gold through Hong Kong.

Markets.title: Gold Prices Fall: Is India’s ₹23 Lakh Crore Gold Loan Market at Risk? | The Morning Brief Decode
Markets.summary: Gold prices have declined, raising concerns about the stability of India's massive ₹23 lakh crore gold loan market. Financial analysts are examining how these lower valuations might impact borrowers and lenders within the sector.

Markets.title: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a negative start; Asian shares trade higher
Markets.summary: GIFT Nifty indicates a negative opening for the Indian stock market. Meanwhile, Asian shares are trading higher.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks rise for second day, crude oil gains
Markets.summary: Asian stock markets rose for the second consecutive day on Friday, with regional indexes in Japan, Australia, and South Korea climbing. Additionally, crude oil prices gained during the session.

Geo-Political.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told the BBC that the US is too focused on the Middle East and is not pushing Russia hard enough. He also stated that it is strange for Donald Trump to describe Vladimir Putin as a friend.

Geo-Political.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
Geo-Political.summary: Severe storms struck both U.S. coasts on Thursday, causing widespread flooding, flight delays, and wind gusts. Nearly one million customers lost power as a result of the Thanksgiving holiday weather.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
Geo-Political.summary: Severe storms across the United States have torn roofs off buildings and flooded streets. The extreme weather has affected hundreds of thousands of people at the start of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.

Geo-Political.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
Geo-Political.summary: New Zealand's right-leaning ruling bloc, led by the National Party, failed to secure an outright parliamentary majority. The coalition fell short of the required threshold by a single seat.

Geo-Political.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: A German boat dealer is suspected by the BBC of supplying boats and engines to Channel smuggling gangs. These vessels were allegedly used in nearly a third of migrant crossings in early 2026.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC confronted Marvin Reuter, a German man who is fighting extradition to France. He faces charges of smuggling, criminal conspiracy, and involuntary manslaughter for allegedly supplying small boats to migrant gangs.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications and features work without needing to read the source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and assembly code to reverse engineer software.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic compared to traditional search engine optimization (SEO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help creators improve their digital content creation in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the industry by streamlining workflows and making creators' lives easier.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for content creation. The platform allows users to generate, share, and monetize their AI-created content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries to drive innovation and efficiency. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity for a wide range of applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top ten artificial intelligence content generator tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create efficient, engaging, and relevant content for their audience.

Data & Insights.title: South Korea raises rates to 2-year high as inflation and housing prices remain a worry
Data & Insights.summary: South Korea's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent. The bank acted to address inflation that remains above target and rising housing prices in Seoul.

Data & Insights.title: UAE eyes 7-8% growth next year as IMF reverses recession forecast, projects 0.2% expansion
Data & Insights.summary: The UAE economy minister forecasts 7% to 8% growth next year, while the IMF projects a modest 0.2% expansion in 2026. This potential recovery depends on the outcome of the Iran conflict, prompting the UAE to prioritize investments in crisis-resilient industries.

Data & Insights.title: India’s Q2 GDP growth to slow marginally to 7.6%, shows Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q2 GDP growth is expected to slow marginally to 7.6% due to a deficient monsoon and uneven rural demand. However, resilient manufacturing and services activity are projected to continue supporting the broader economy.

Data & Insights.title: India rejects US' structural excess capacity allegations as Washington links 17% tariff to trade deal, 25% otherwise
Data & Insights.summary: India rejected U.S. allegations of structural excess capacity in any of its sectors. Washington proposed a 17% tariff if the two nations reach a bilateral trade deal, and a 25% tariff otherwise.

Data & Insights.title: US proposes extra tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, 17% after trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: The United States has proposed an additional tariff of up to 25% on Indian goods, which could be reduced to 17% if a trade agreement is reached. This development affects the US market, which is India's largest export destination with shipments exceeding $87 billion in the fiscal year ending March 2026.

Data & Insights.title: RBI shifts more gold home amid geopolitical uncertainty
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has moved more of its gold reserves back home from foreign jurisdictions. Central banks are increasingly repatriating these assets due to rising geopolitical uncertainties and risks associated with foreign storage.

India.title: Rajkot Demolition Fraud: 1 Official Suspended, 2 Others Under Probe
India.summary: One official has been suspended in connection with a demolition fraud case in Rajkot. Additionally, departmental inquiries and probes have been initiated against two other officials and a health department employee for negligence and budget overruns.

India.title: 'Desh Ki Shaan Hai': Piyush Goyal Announces New Marketing Campaign For Darjeeling Tea
India.summary: Indian Minister Piyush Goyal announced a new marketing campaign called 'Desh Ki Shaan Hai' for Darjeeling tea. The government launched this initiative to help restore the historical glory of the region's tea industry.

India.title: US Envoy Sergio Gor Celebrates Thanksgiving With US Marines In Delhi
India.summary: US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor celebrated Thanksgiving with the Marine Security Guard Detachment in New Delhi. He shared a special holiday meal with the detachment during the visit.

India.title: UP Man Dies At Delhi Hospital, Wives Accuse Mother, Sisters Of Poisoning: Cops
India.summary: A man from Uttar Pradesh died at a Delhi hospital under suspicious circumstances. His two wives accused his mother and sisters of poisoning him.

India.title: DMK To Join Hands With BJP? TVK's Big Claim Amid Delimitation Buzz
India.summary: Tamil Nadu's TVK party claimed that the ruling DMK might form an alliance with the BJP amid concerns over the upcoming delimitation exercise. The DMK has strongly denied this allegation.

India.title: "From Farm Laws to Chitta": Bhagwant Mann Questions SAD-BJP U-Turns
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann criticized the newly reformed Shiromani Akali Dal-BJP alliance. He accused the two parties of misleading the people of Punjab for 25 years on issues like farm laws and drug addiction.

General.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told the BBC that the United States is too focused on the Middle East and is not applying enough pressure on Russia. He also stated that Donald Trump's description of Vladimir Putin as a friend is "strange."

General.title: Huntingdon train attacker found guilty of all 14 counts of attempted murder
General.summary: Anthony Williams, 33, was found guilty of 14 counts of attempted murder following a series of attacks on a train and in Peterborough and London. The conviction covers a total of 10 attacks committed on a train and four others across the two cities.

General.title: Knifeman told doctor his psychosis drugs weren't working days before Huntingdon attack
General.summary: Anthony Williams told a doctor his psychosis medication was not working just days before he attacked a passenger on an LNER train in Huntingdon. Following the conclusion of his trial, details of his long criminal history have now been made public.

General.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
General.summary: Severe Thanksgiving storms on both US coasts caused heavy rain, flooding, and wind gusts on Thursday. The weather left nearly one million customers without power and caused widespread flight delays.

General.title: Drug rape husband says wife 'would have been terrified', court hears
General.summary: A husband testified in court that his wife never would have agreed to be drugged and sexually assaulted. He told the jury that she would have been terrified by the actions.

General.title: Met Police ruined my life, says Kenyan man wrongly sentenced over attack on UK couple
General.summary: A Kenyan man named Ali Kololo has stated that the Metropolitan Police ruined his life after he was wrongfully convicted of a 2011 attack on a British couple in Lamu. His conviction was based on evidence provided by a British police officer.
